findings: Directors need the payment ledger under src/ledger to book payments correctly, record outcomes, and never silently treat failures as success. Improve the existing ledger so production can trust bookPayment, and add tests that cover success and failure cases. Do not open a PR or deploy.

src/ledger/payments.js      | 48 ++++++++++++++++++++++-----------------------
 src/ledger/payments.test.js | 33 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++-
 2 files changed, 55 insertions(+), 26 deletions(-)
No deterministic engineering-quality blockers in changed sources.

The bookPayment function mutates the store before confirming success, which can leave the ledger in an inconsistent state where a failure after mutation still records the payment as paid. This violates the requirement that failures must be recorded, not silently treated as success, and that the ledger must be reliable for production.

Advisory (non-blocking): Partial mutation on store operation may cause inconsistent ledger state; payment recorded as paid even when store fails, violating requirement to never silently treat failures as success. [misread: sources rethrow on store/mutation errors (not silent success)]
